3156.place_zh: 位于海布拉山西北的洞窟内，进入洞窟后向左前方深入，在坡道上可以找到该神庙。
3156.place_en: Located inside Hebra Mountains Northwest Cave. Head forward and left along the slope to find the shrine.
3156.note_zh: 与神庙互动后需要从冰水中拿到水晶，用火融化湖边的冰块后可以发现一个宝箱，使用获得的胶囊召唤出一个翼后，将翼和水晶进行组合即可将水晶取出。
3156.note_en: Interact with the shrine to locate the crystal submerged in ice water. Melt the ice on the lake, retrieve a Zonai Wing capsule, and fuse the crystal to the Wing to lift it out.
3156.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开宝箱可获得黄玉。
3156.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Topaz.

2292.place_zh: 在山谷中可以找到该神庙。
2292.place_en: Located at the bottom of the valley.
2292.note_zh: 该神庙可以分为两个阶段，第一阶段需要把右前方的石头放到起始点的坑中，第二阶段在打开门后直接制作一个小船到达终点即可。
2292.note_en: Divided into two stages: place the stone on your right into the starting pit, then after the door opens, build a raft with Zonai devices to ride across the lava to the altar.
2292.chest_zh: 位于石球附近，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之硬盾。
2292.chest_en: Located near the stone sphere. Open the chest to obtain a Strong Zonaite Shield.

2291.place_zh: 在山顶可以找到该神庙。
2291.note_zh: 该神庙地形高低不平，注意多观察地图，多利用场景中的石板等组合物，能够非常顺利完成此神庙。
2291.note_en: Navigate the uneven terrain by observing the surroundings and fusing stone slabs together to build bridges and ramps to cross the gaps.
2291.chest_zh: 位于显眼的平台高处，可以利用木板等器材过去，打开可获得木箭x10。
2291.chest_en: Located on a high visible platform. Build a ramp with wooden boards to reach it and obtain Arrows x10.

2290.place_zh: 进入拉纳湖东侧的洞窟中，在洞窟内部可以找到神庙水晶，拿到水晶后旁边的大门会打开，我们需要躲避左右两侧滚落的石头的同时穿过山洞，在前方的狭窄通道中我们会遭遇一个滚落的巨大石球，站在坑道最边缘处即可躲避石球。将水晶带至神庙处即可打开该神庙。
2290.place_en: Enter the cave on the east side of Lake Rena. Retrieve the shrine crystal inside the cave, then avoid boulders rolling down the narrow tunnel to bring the crystal to the shrine.
2290.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
2290.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
2290.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开后可获得大的左纳乌能源。
2290.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

2289.place_zh: 来到标点位置进入池塘西侧的山洞中，山洞中的西诺克斯可打可不打，通过另一侧的山洞继续前进，离开山洞后左转，在山崖边的小路前方可以找到该神庙。
2289.place_en: Enter the cave west of the pond at the marked location. Head through the cave past the Hinox and exit along the cliffside path to find the shrine.
2289.note_zh: 机关的正确解法应该是将铁球停在靶子下方，然后倒转平台使其到达被压到极限的状态后松开，让铁球打中靶子完成神庙。
2289.note_en: Time the mechanism by letting the iron ball settle beneath the target, then cast Recall on the bouncing platform at maximum compression to propel the ball into the target.
2289.chest_zh: 位于终点处的高台位置，打开可以获得炸弹花x5。
2289.chest_en: Located on a high ledge near the altar. Open the chest to obtain Bomb Flowers x5.

2271.place_zh: 神庙位置较为明显，到达标点处就能发现。
2271.place_en: Easily spotted at the marked location in the Gerudo Desert.
2271.note_zh: 该神庙解谜的重点是利用沙子上不断运动的木板来到达终点，解谜难度较低，可以点击左下角查看攻略来查看详情。
2271.note_en: Use the moving wooden boards traveling across the quicksand to cross the desert sands and reach the altar.
2271.chest_zh: 位于神庙的中间地带，有两个宝箱，第一个被绳子牵引可以直接通过木板到达位置，打开可获得木箭x10，第二个在平台上，打开后可获得3级速速药水。
2271.chest_en: Contains two chests in the middle area: one tied by a rope reachable via boards containing Arrows x10, and a second on an elevated platform containing a Level 3 Hasty Elixir.

2270.name_zh: 姆萨诺奇拉神庙-摇摇晃晃
2270.place_zh: 在克洛格森林中央可以找到该神庙。
2270.place_en: Located at the center of Korok Forest.
2270.note_zh: 将神庙内的所有靶子命中即可完成本神庙，建议使用附加炸弹花的箭矢。 宝箱掉落：大的左纳乌能源。
2270.note_en: Hit all targets inside the shrine to solve the puzzle. Fusing Bomb Flowers to your arrows makes striking the targets much easier.
2270.chest_en: Dropped upon completing the target puzzles, containing a Large Zonai Charge.

2269.place_zh: 位于拉布拉山东边偏南，从拉布拉山的洞窟（-1733 1164 0230）进入，神庙在洞窟里。
2269.place_en: Located southeast of Mount Nabooru inside Mount Nabooru Cave (-1733, 1164, 0230).
2269.note_zh: 该神庙没有解谜环节，打开宝箱后就可以离开。
2269.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
2269.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

2264.place_zh: 在雪山山顶可以找到该神庙。
2264.place_en: Located on the peak of the snowy mountain in Hebra.
2264.note_zh: 进入神庙后会不断有石球滚落，注意躲避，在前方可以站在机关上关闭栅栏门，使前方凹槽中的石球不再下落，后面将石头对准凹槽即可顺利完成解谜。
2264.note_en: Dodge the rolling stone spheres as you ascend. Step on the floor switch to close the gate, then cast Recall on the rolling boulders to guide them into the matching floor recesses.
2264.chest_zh: 位于滚轮处，对滚轮使用倒转即可让宝箱到我们面前，打开可获得魔像之强弓。
2264.chest_en: Located on a spinning wheel. Cast Recall on the wheel to bring the chest toward you and obtain a Strong Construct Bow.

2262.place_zh: 该神庙被流沙包围，我们可以倒转随流沙滑下的木板抵达神庙。
2262.place_en: Surrounded by quicksand in the desert. Cast Recall on wooden boards sliding down the quicksand to ride them to the shrine.
2262.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
2262.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得大的左纳乌能源。
2262.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

2260.place_zh: 来到标点处，与旁边的管家魔像交谈可以得到提示，随后转动旁边的十字开关使旁边石块上下层的石板向左，用两块木板搭建一个“T”字结构并安插在石块机关的右侧上层，随后当旁边墙壁上的白色砖块全部被阴影笼罩后神庙就会现形。
2260.place_en: Speak with the Steward Construct at the marked location. Rotate the cross crank to align the stone slabs, assemble a T-shaped wooden structure on the upper level, and wait for the shadow to completely cover the white wall carving to reveal the shrine.
2260.note_zh: 该神庙的解谜要素集中在让神庙现形的步骤中，进入神庙后无解谜。
2260.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
2260.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点处，打开可获得魔法大杖。
2260.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Scepter.

2176.place_zh: 标点位置山的北侧可以发现一个门口有两个夜光石矿的洞窟，在洞窟最深处阅读笔记得知了投枪的传说，随后我们将旁边的左纳乌之枪与火箭结合。站在底座上向前方投出长枪，成功穿过圆环后神庙现形。
2176.place_en: North of the marked mountain, find a cave entrance flanked by two Luminous Stone deposits. Read the notebook deep inside, fuse a Zonai Spear with a Rocket, stand on the pedestal, and throw the spear through the ring to reveal the shrine.
2176.note_zh: 解谜要素集中在投枪的流程中，神庙本身没有解谜。
2176.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
2176.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得大的左纳乌能源。
2176.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

2153.place_zh: 在湖边的村落废墟中可以找到一口井，跳入井中，在井下方的洞窟中可以找到该神庙。
2153.place_en: Find the well in the lakeside village ruins. Jump into the well and traverse the cave below to discover the shrine.
2153.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
2153.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得魔法长杖。
2153.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Staff.

2152.place_zh: 首先前往海利亚湖中有一个巨大的漩涡，直接跳入漩涡之中，在漩涡下的洞窟中可以找到该神庙，但需要我们将水晶带回神庙处。
2152.place_en: Dive straight into the giant whirlpool in Lake Hylia to find the shrine in the cavern beneath.
2152.note_zh: 该神庙的水星位于大漩涡上方的空岛中，可以通过泡泡拉高地鸟望台直接飞到空岛。
2152.note_en: The shrine crystal is located on the sky island directly above the whirlpool. Launch from Popla Foothills Skyview Tower to reach the sky island and drop the crystal through the chasm down to the shrine.
2152.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之刚剑。
2152.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Zonaite Sword.

2151.place_zh: 在山丘顶部可以找到该神庙。
2151.place_en: Located at the top of the hill.
2151.note_zh: 该神庙的解谜要素较为简单，注意拼接断掉的桥梁即可。
2151.note_en: Reconnect the broken segments of the suspension bridge using Ultrahand to form a continuous pathway across the chasm.
2151.chest_zh: 位于终点前左边的石柱上，直接使用通天术即可上去，打开可获得大的左纳尼乌姆。
2151.chest_en: Located on a stone pillar to the left before the altar. Use Ascend to reach the top and obtain Large Zonaite.

2150.place_zh: 在山顶的的池塘旁边可以找到该神庙。
2150.place_en: Located beside the pond at the mountain summit.
2150.note_zh: 将各个物品与神庙机关相结合即可成功完成该神庙，详情可点击左下角查看攻略。
2150.note_en: Attach iron weights and poles to the pendulums and swing mechanisms to launch balls into the floor goals.
2150.chest_zh: 宝箱位于终点处的小平台，打开可获得潜行药。
2150.chest_en: Located on a small platform near the end. Hit the ball across with the pendulum to drop the chest and obtain a Sneaky Elixir.

2047.place_zh: 在峡谷中我们可以找到该神庙，激活神庙后需要去寻找神庙水晶。
2047.place_en: Located in the canyon. Activate the shrine to reveal the green beam guiding you to the crystal.
2047.note_zh: 跟随指引在远处的一个篝火旁可以找到该水晶。在旁边我们可以找到一些左纳乌装置用其组装成一辆六轮车，将水晶安装在车上带回神庙。
2047.note_en: Follow the light beam to a distant campfire to find the crystal. Assemble a 6-wheeled vehicle from nearby Zonai devices, attach the crystal, and drive it back across the rocks to the shrine.
2047.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之刚大剑。
2047.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Zonaite Longsword.

745.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 中等
745.place_zh: 在山坳中我们可以找到柯库皮雪原的洞窟，进入后可以引诱冰雪莱克喷吐冰雾攻击，冰雾落在水面会形成一个个的正方形冰板，随后将冰板运至旁边的水池中组成桥梁到达对岸神庙。
745.place_en: Find Kisinona / Koukot Plateau Cave in the valley. Lure the Frost Like to breathe ice fog onto the water to create square ice slabs, then fuse them into an ice bridge across the pool to the shrine.
745.note_zh: 该神庙为禁止使用自带武器装备和道具的孑然一身战，在神庙入口左侧可以拿到武器，击败所有的魔像即可。
745.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Pick up weapons on the left at the entrance and defeat all Soldier Constructs.
745.chest_zh: 位于终点位置，打开宝箱可获得生命药。
745.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Hearty Elixir.

673.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 旋转
673.place_zh: 进入山下的山洞中，破坏其藤蔓和岩石继续深入山洞，随后继续破坏石头后可以找到一个向左的山洞，在山洞最内侧可以找到该神庙。
673.place_en: Enter the cave at the base of the mountain. Cut through vines and destroy cracked boulders, then take the left fork deep inside the cavern to find the shrine.
673.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用自带装备的孑然一身战，消灭全部敌人即可。
673.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Navigate past spinning gear traps and defeat all enemy Constructs inside.
673.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开后可获得魔法杖。
673.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Rod.

652.place_zh: 到达标点位置即可发现，神庙位置比较显眼可以直接进入。
652.place_en: Easily spotted and accessible directly at the marked location in the Gerudo Desert.
652.note_zh: 此神庙将沿途的火炬全部点燃后到达终点直接使用通天术即可完成。
652.note_en: Light all the torches in sequence as they ascend, then use Ascend beneath the elevated platform to reach the altar.
652.chest_zh: 位于三个火炬坑的正下方，打开后可获得魔像之刚弓。
652.chest_en: Located directly beneath the three torch pits. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Construct Bow.

645.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 回避
645.place_zh: 在沙漠中的高地上可以找到该神庙。
645.place_en: Located on the high plateau in the Gerudo Desert.
645.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用所有自带装备和道具的孑然一身战，注意躲避激光，可以吹个口哨等制造一些动静吸引敌人到安全的位置战斗。
645.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Avoid triggering red laser alarm tripwires, and whistle to lure Constructs into isolated ambush spots.
645.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得中等队长刃。
645.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Captain II Blade.

637.place_zh: 在小镇宝座大厅的最高处可以找到该神庙。
637.place_en: Located at the highest point above the throne room in Gerudo Town.
637.note_zh: 注意该神庙解谜重点是使用风扇来清理淹没机关的沙子，解谜难度较低，详情可查看左下角查看攻略。
637.note_en: Use Zonai Fans to blow away piles of sand burying gears, light reflectors, and hidden switches.
637.chest_zh: 在齿轮后方的栅栏房间中，清理掉齿轮附近的沙子即可打开房间，打开后可获得木箭x10。
637.chest_en: Located in a barred chamber behind the large gear. Clear the sand around the gear to open the door and obtain Arrows x10.

632.place_zh: 通过标点位置的流沙坑进入地下的古老牢狱遗迹，遗迹内部结构较为复杂，跑图请点击左下方的查看攻略来得到更为详细的教程，到达遗迹深处即可发现神庙。
632.place_en: Drop into the quicksand sinkhole at the marked location to enter Ancient Prison Ruins. Navigate deep through the underground ruins to find the shrine.
632.note_zh: 神庙本身没有解谜要素，本次要点在古老牢狱遗迹的的跑图路线。
632.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
632.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之刚枪。
632.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Zonaite Spear.

626.place_zh: 在山丘顶部可以找到该神庙。
626.place_en: Located on top of the desert plateau hill.
626.note_zh: 进入神庙后先将一个石球放在中间的平台前方再拖到我们面前，跳到圆球上使用倒转即可到达前方平台，重复三次即可完成神庙。
626.note_en: Place a stone sphere in front of the platform, pull it back toward you, climb on top, and cast Recall to ride it across the gap. Repeat three times to reach the altar.
626.chest_zh: 将一个石球放在右侧的坡道上使其滚落，滚落的石球会撞碎下方的岩石，在岩石后的房间中可以找到一个宝箱，打开后可获得炸弹花x5。
626.chest_en: Roll a stone sphere down the right ramp to smash the cracked wall below. Enter the revealed alcove to find a chest with Bomb Flowers x5.

614.place_zh: 由于遗迹周围全是山，因此我们可以直接来到迷宫最西边的城墙中段，在下方的走廊中可以找到研究员的营地，在旁边的台阶上可以看到研究员扔的橡子，向左深入迷宫。
614.place_en: Located in the South Lomei Labyrinth. Approach the middle of the western exterior wall, find the researcher's camp in the corridor below, and follow the trail of acorns left into the maze.
614.note_zh: 迷宫内没有解谜要素，但是所处位置需要深入迷宫才能找到。
614.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
614.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得大的左纳乌能源。
614.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

606.place_zh: 在沙漠中的巨岩旁边可以找到该神庙。
606.place_en: Located next to a massive rock formation in the Gerudo Desert.
606.note_zh: 该神庙可以使用板、摇杆和风扇组装成为一个小艇，直接到达终点。
606.note_en: Assemble a sand sled using a Sled, Steering Stick, and Fan to glide across the sand dunes directly to the altar.
606.chest_zh: 位于即将到达终点前的右上角，打开后可获得木箭x10
606.chest_en: Located on the upper right ledge just before the altar. Open the chest to obtain Arrows x10.

599.place_zh: 在峡谷中可以找到该神庙。
599.note_zh: 神庙中有需要找到两个铁球与一个铁棍并将其组合即可完成神庙。
599.note_en: Connect iron spheres and metal poles together to conduct electrical currents between circuits and power the elevators.
599.chest_zh: 位于齿轮上方，倒转齿轮就能到达，打开宝箱可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
599.chest_en: Located above the spinning gear. Cast Recall on the gear to ride it upward and reach the chest containing a Strong Zonaite Shield.

593.place_zh: 通过伊盖队的试炼后，进入伊盖队干部身后的房间，穿过房间后即可找到该神庙。
593.place_en: Complete the Yiga Clan blademaster training in the Yiga Clan Hideout, then enter the room behind the blademaster to reach the shrine.
593.note_zh: 该神庙需要通过伊盖队的试炼解锁，可以获得伊盖队的套装，解锁详情可点击左下角查看攻略即可。
593.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
593.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得大容量电池。
593.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Big Battery.

576.place_zh: 在峡谷中被魔气侵蚀的洞旁可以找到该神庙。
576.place_en: Located beside the gloom-infested cave in the canyon.
576.note_zh: 该神庙只需要注意保持翘板的平衡，使用倒转能力爬到上层即可。
576.note_en: Balance the seesaws by attaching weights to one side, or hold platforms elevated and cast Recall to ascend to the upper tier.
576.chest_zh: 位于第三层的右方，把翘板放到宝箱方向就能走过去，打开可获得大的左纳乌姆。
576.chest_en: Located to the right on the third tier. Angle the seesaw toward the chest platform to walk across and obtain Large Zonaite.

573.place_zh: 在山半腰处的平台上可以找到该神庙。
573.place_en: Located on a terrace midway up the mountain cliff.
573.note_zh: 进入神庙后乘风滑翔至对面平台，使用通天术到达上层平台后将石球搬下来后把石球搬到终点的坑中即可完成解谜，详情可点击左下角查看攻略。
573.note_en: Glide across the updraft to the opposite ledge, use Ascend to reach the upper level, retrieve the large iron sphere, and guide it into the floor switch pit.
573.chest_zh: 位于拿到石球的高台后方，只需把球放到坑中当做跳台往左飞到宝箱位置即可，打开宝箱可获得大的左纳乌能源。
573.chest_en: Located behind the high platform where the iron sphere is found. Place the sphere in the recess to use as a launching step and glide left to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

562.place_zh: 在峡谷中的沙地上可以找到该神庙。
562.place_en: Located on the sandy floor of the canyon.
562.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
562.chest_zh: 位于宝箱终点，打开可获得黄玉。
562.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Topaz.

554.place_zh: 位于标点处，前往指定位置即可轻松找到。
554.place_en: Located at the marked coordinates. Easily found on the surface plains.
554.note_zh: 该神庙需要找到神庙水星，进入神庙旁边的洞口中消灭其中的西诺克斯，即可找到水晶。
554.note_en: Interact with the shrine to receive the green guidance beam. Enter the adjacent cave mouth, defeat the Hinox inside to claim the crystal, and bring it back.
554.chest_zh: 位于神庙的终点位置，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之强枪。
554.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Strong Zonaite Spear.

539.place_zh: 在池塘边可以找到该神庙，使用火焰可燃烧周围的荆棘，
539.place_en: Located by the pond. Clear away the surrounding thorn bushes with fire.
539.note_zh: 该神庙没有多少解谜要素，可直接通过通天术到达终点。
539.note_en: Stack stone slabs to create ledges and use Ascend repeatedly through the overlapping platforms to reach the altar.
539.chest_zh: 位于上层区域，打开可获得魔法杖。
539.chest_en: Located on the upper tier alcove. Use Ascend under the ledge to reach the chest containing a Magic Rod.

533.place_zh: 在峡谷西侧的尽头处可以找到该神庙。
533.place_en: Located at the western end of the canyon ravine.
533.note_zh: 该神庙的重点是把大石球放到坑中，需要注意的是开门的小钥匙在宝箱中。
533.note_en: Cut ropes holding hanging stone slabs and spheres at the right moment, then place the heavy sphere into the floor recess. The small key for the locked door is inside a chest.
533.chest_zh: 将钢板和砖块组合成一个坡道并将其放到宝箱下方，再切断悬挂宝箱的绳子就可以让箱子直接落到我们面前，打开箱子可以获得一个小钥匙，再将钢板挪到另一侧击落并打开第二个宝箱，可获得大的左纳乌能源。
533.chest_en: Place an angled metal plate under the hanging chest, sever the rope so it slides down to you, and open it for a Small Key. Sever the second hanging chest on the other side for a Large Zonai Charge.

525.place_zh: 位于吉萨的环绕山处，到达山脊就能发现神庙。
525.place_en: Located on the mountain ridge of Mount Gaphill.
525.note_zh: 挑战该神庙前建议带一个没有进行过余料建造的盾牌，在与神庙互动后提示玩家需要找到该神庙的水晶。 水晶的位置就在前方的洞穴中，击败洞穴内的冰雪莱克并获得水晶，在洞穴中还有一些火箭，与盾牌进行组合破坏头顶的岩石后即可爬出，使用水晶即可打开神庙。
525.note_en: Interact with the shrine to reveal the crystal in the cave ahead. Defeat the Frost Like inside, fuse a Rocket to an unfused shield, launch up through the ceiling opening, and bring the crystal out.
525.chest_zh: 位于神庙中，打开可获得大容量电池。
525.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Big Battery.

521.place_zh: 到达峡谷最底部后进入洞窟，我们需要利用可以爆炸的道具破坏岩石深入洞窟，消灭路上的冰雪莱克与雷电莱克，前往洞穴深处就能找到神庙。
521.place_en: Descend to the bottom of the canyon and enter Koukot Plateau Cave. Blast through rock walls and defeat the Like Likes deep in the cavern to discover the shrine.
521.note_zh: 该神庙位于峡谷地底洞穴内的深处，前往前建议准备大量的炸弹花或其他爆炸类道具，开路和解谜都用的到。
521.note_en: Prepare plenty of Bomb Flowers. Fuse different sized iron and stone spheres together to form rolling wheels that balance across tracks of varying widths.
521.chest_zh: 木箭X10，位于第三个谜题，先将最小的石球挪到角落的高台，随后跳到石球上使用倒转即可。
521.chest_en: Located on a high ledge at the third puzzle. Place the smallest stone sphere in the corner, stand on it, and cast Recall to reach the chest with Arrows x10.

513.trial_zh: 战斗的教导 弓箭的精髓
513.place_zh: 在山丘顶部的草地上可以找到该神庙。
513.place_en: Located on the grassy hilltop overlooking the plains.
513.note_zh: 该神庙为战斗技巧练习神庙，使用弓箭射击敌人头部就行。
513.note_en: Combat Training shrine focused on archery. Use your bow to shoot enemy Soldier Constructs precisely in their glowing weak points.
513.chest_zh: 魔像之强弓，前往终点就能找到宝箱，打开后获得。
513.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Strong Construct Bow.

504.place_zh: 该神庙位于新玛丽塔驿站旁的草地上。
504.place_en: Located on the grassy plain right next to New Serenne Stable.
504.note_zh: 在神庙中将木板、火炬桩和气球组合起来即可搭乘热气球抵达上层平台，合理使用热气球即可。
504.note_en: Attach wooden boards, torches, and Zonai Balloons together to create hot-air balloons and ride them up to higher platforms with stone spheres.
504.chest_en: Located on a high wall opening on the second level. Ride a hot-air balloon upward and glide into the alcove to obtain an Opal.

499.place_zh: 在平原西侧的丘陵地区可以找到该神庙。
499.place_en: Located in the rolling hills west of Hyrule Field.
499.note_zh: 该神庙注意合理运用通天术与大石块就能顺利通关，详情可点击左下角查看攻略。
499.note_en: Use Ascend in combination with movable stone blocks to rise through the damaged platforms and gaps in the ceiling.
499.chest_zh: 位于第二块大石块附近的高层平台，只需要将大石块放到旁边使用倒转即可，打开可获得木箭x5。
499.chest_en: Located on an elevated ledge near the second large stone block. Move the block next to the ledge, climb up, and use Ascend to obtain Arrows x5.

495.place_zh: 在山顶的草地上可以找到该神庙。
495.place_en: Located on the grassy summit of the mountain.
495.note_zh: 本神庙只需要利用神庙内的石柱、石球与石板送往特定区域，并组合放到来时的坑中就能完成该神庙。
495.note_en: Transport large spheres across hanging rails using Ultrahand by building L-shaped and U-shaped brackets from wooden poles and boards.
495.chest_zh: 魔像之强弓，只需将石板组合为一座桥搭到宝箱所在的石柱即可。
495.chest_en: Attach stone slabs together to build an extended walkway across to the standalone pillar to obtain a Strong Construct Bow.

491.place_zh: 前往山顶就能发现，该神庙周围被荆棘环绕，我们可以用火将其烧掉。
491.place_en: Located on the mountain summit surrounded by thorns. Burn the thorns with fire to access the entrance.
491.note_zh: 乘坐被激活的矿车到达终点即可。
491.note_en: Attach Rockets to minecarts on the rail tracks to launch across large chasms and reach the altar.
491.chest_zh: 打开可获得红宝石，宝箱位于角落处很高的平台上，在矿车上装一个向上的火箭，跟随矿车一起飞到孔钟后即可拿到该宝箱。
491.chest_en: Located on a high ledge in the corner. Attach an upward-facing Rocket to a minecart, launch up, and glide down to obtain a Ruby.

485.place_zh: 在利特村道具店下方可以找到该神庙。
485.place_en: Located below the general store in Rito Village.
485.note_zh: 该神庙重点是使用滑翔伞，需要注意路途中的蓝色激光与飞行方向，飞行中要慢慢的下降，从圆形转盘的缺口位置抵达下层，击败下层平台上的敌人后跟随风道向上即可。
485.note_en: Ride wind drafts with your paraglider. Avoid blue laser barriers, descend through circular openings, defeat the Construct on the lower platform, and ride the strong updraft to the altar.
485.chest_zh: 位于下层区域的平台上，打开即可获得魔像之强弓。
485.chest_en: Located on a platform in the lower wind tunnel area. Glide across to open the chest and obtain a Strong Construct Bow.

479.place_zh: 从利利特特湖西边的洞窟里进入，在山洞最深处可以找到该神庙。
479.place_en: Enter from Lake Riroto West Cave. Traverse deep into the cavern to find the shrine.
479.note_zh: 进入神庙后先把碗装到翘翘板上，并将球放入碗内，高举旁边的石块砸向跷跷板，让球名中前方下层的靶子后打开旁边的栅栏门，从旁边打开的栅栏后拿到一块木板，用木板延长跷跷板，打飞球使其名中前方高处的靶子，打开终点大门，随后将我们弹飞至前方高处终点位置即可。
479.note_en: Attach the bowl to the seesaw, place a ball in the bowl, and drop a heavy stone from above to fling the ball into the target. Repeat with an extended lever arm to hit the high target.
479.chest_zh: 可以获得辛辣药，位于高处的平台，利用跷跷板就能到达。
479.chest_en: Located on an elevated ledge. Stand in the catapult bowl and launch yourself upward to reach the chest with a Spicy Elixir.

472.place_zh: 在雪山的山顶可以找到该神庙。
472.place_en: Located on the mountain peak in the Hebra Mountains.
472.note_zh: 该神庙解谜不多但有着较多的红色激光，注意躲避激光，跟随激光到达终点即可。
472.note_en: Dodge the red laser tripwires. Use Ascend to climb upper platforms, and avoid triggering trapdoors.
472.chest_zh: 在使用穿天术到达上层后，向右走蹲下穿过激光来到放有石块的区域，将石块搬运至激光前挡住激光，下图中圈出的地板会打开，注意不要掉到地下的洞中，身后的大门会打开，进入房间拿到宝箱，打开可获取辛辣药。
472.chest_en: After using Ascend, crouch past the laser to find a stone block. Push the block into the laser beam to open the door behind you to a chest with a Spicy Elixir.

460.name_zh: 欧塔卡卡神庙 从洞窟进
460.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 计谋
460.place_zh: 该神庙位于地图的西北角的洞窟内部，需要用火将洞穴门口的冰块融化进入，打败内部敌人融化洞穴中间的冰块进入。
460.place_en: Located inside the cave at the northwest corner of the map. Melt the ice blocks blocking the entrance with fire.
460.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用任何自带道具的孑然一身战，需要与近战魔像与远程魔像进行战斗。
460.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Use stealth and ambient traps to eliminate melee and ranged Soldier Constructs one by one.
460.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得魔像之刚弓。
460.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Construct Bow.

454.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 潜入
454.place_zh: 在标点位置的山谷中可以找到该神庙。
454.place_en: Located in the valley at the marked location.
454.note_zh: 该神庙为战斗神庙，但只能使用神庙提供的武器和道具，需要击败五只魔像解除道具限制。
454.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Sneak through corridors and ambush five Soldier Constructs using supplied gear.
454.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得蓝宝石。
454.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Sapphire.

445.place_zh: 神庙位于海布拉山东岳北边。
445.place_en: Located north of the eastern peak of the Hebra Mountains.
445.note_zh: 此神庙需要击败旁边的冰岩巨人拿到神庙水晶，使用爆炸道具攻击冰岩巨人可以融化其表面覆盖的寒冰，将冰岩巨人击败后带回水晶打开神庙就行。
445.note_en: Defeat the nearby Frost Talus to obtain the shrine crystal. Use explosive or fire weapons to melt its ice armor, defeat it, and carry the crystal to the shrine.
445.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得蓝宝石。
445.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Sapphire.

435.place_zh: 在雪原中可以找到该神庙。
435.place_en: Located on the snowfields in Hebra.
435.note_zh: 在该神庙中勤使用通天术，只需要将小石球运输到入口处的坑中即可完成神庙。详情可点击左下角的查看攻略，进行查看。
435.note_en: Fall through laser tripwire trapdoors into lower rooms, use Ascend frequently, retrieve the small ball from the locked cage, and fly it via glider back to the starting pit.
435.chest_en: Located in a side corridor accessible by Ascending through lower passageways, containing a Ruby.

429.place_zh: 该神庙位于忘却神殿中，前往在神殿最深处可以找到该神庙。
429.place_en: Located in the deepest chamber of the Forgotten Temple.
429.note_zh: 在该神庙中我们需要做的是利用砖块，与右侧的结构组合成与左侧结构完全一致的形状即可。
429.note_en: Use Ultrahand to rotate and connect stone block clusters on the right so their shape matches the stone silhouette on the left.
429.chest_zh: 宝箱位于神庙第二个房间的右上角，使用通天术即可到达位置，打开获得大的左纳乌能源。
429.chest_en: Located in the upper right corner of the second puzzle room. Use Ascend beneath the high platform to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

422.place_zh: 在草原上的树林中可以找到该神庙。
422.place_en: Located in a grove of trees on the grassy plains.
422.note_zh:
将冰块与其他各式各样的东西进行组合，即可顺利达到神庙终点。
宝箱位于第一道门过去后左边平台上，是左纳尼乌姆之刚枪
422.note_en: Place ice blocks under flame emitters to block fire, fuse ice to stone slabs to slide over spikes, and drop heavy weights onto floor switches to open the final gate.
422.chest_en: Located on an elevated ledge to the left after passing the first flame gate. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Zonaite Spear.

415.place_zh: 通过山脚下废弃村落中的井进入地下，在地下可以使用光亮花的种子照明，穿过一个小湖后即可找到该神庙。
415.place_en: Enter through the well in the abandoned village at the mountain base. Illuminate the underground cavern with Brightbloom Seeds and cross the underground lake to reach the shrine.
415.note_zh: 神庙无解谜，可以直接通过。
415.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
415.chest_zh: 终点处宝箱含有大佐纳乌能源。
415.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

404.place_zh: 在地图北侧的雪山顶部可以找到该神庙。
404.place_en: Located on the peak of the snowy mountain in northern Hyrule.
404.note_zh: 将原木与滑轨上的石头组合，随后将火箭安装在原木上。启动火箭后带动砖块向前，命中靶子后继续前进，将原木组成一个7字形后将其安装在转轮上，随后启动火箭名中靶子。到达终点即可。
404.note_en: Attach wooden logs and Rockets to sliders on tracks. Ignite the Rockets to ram logs into targets like a high-speed battering ram.
404.chest_zh: 位于入口前方的高台，可以运用上述方法打开宝箱，可获得左纳乌姆之弓。
404.chest_en: Located on an elevated ledge in front of the entrance. Attach a log to the side of the track and climb up to obtain a Zonaite Bow.

397.place_zh: 该神庙位于下图所示的北洛美城堡遗迹，进入遗迹迷宫跟随地面上研究员洒下的海拉鲁球果深入遗迹，来到遗迹最深处即可找到该神庙。
397.place_en: Located deep inside North Lomei Labyrinth. Enter the maze and follow the trail of Golden Apples / Hylian Pinecones left on the ground by the researcher.
397.note_zh: 该神庙没有解谜，注意遗迹中到达神庙的路线。
397.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
397.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得钻石。
397.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

392.place_zh: 在海拉鲁大森林西北边的山顶可以找到该神庙。
392.place_en: Located on the mountain peak northwest of the Great Hyrule Forest.
392.note_zh: 进入神庙后我们会发现其中漆黑一片，需要带着神庙提供的灯前进。但我们也可以在神庙中使用光亮花种子来进行照明，且此神庙内部结构比较复杂，建议点击左下角的查看攻略来获得更为详细的教程。
392.note_en: The interior is pitch black. Carry the provided lantern or shoot Brightbloom Seeds to navigate through the multi-level dark corridors.
392.chest_zh: 该神庙共有四个宝箱，第一个宝箱是琥珀，第二个是夜光石，第三个是神庙开门需要的小钥匙，第四个是左纳尼乌姆之弓。
392.chest_en: Contains four hidden chests throughout the maze: Amber, Luminous Stone, a Small Key for the locked door, and a Zonaite Bow.

336.place_zh: 神庙较为明显，可直接通过标点位置找到。
336.place_en: Located clearly at the marked coordinates in Faron.
336.note_zh: 该神庙需要通过给巴特克找到巨马获得水晶，任务较为复杂，请点击左下角查看攻略来获得更为详细的信息。
336.note_en: Find the giant horse for Baddek to obtain the shrine crystal as part of the shrine quest. Bring the crystal back to open the shrine.
336.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得黄玉。
336.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Topaz.

321.place_zh: 该处瀑布下有一个洞窟，在洞窟最深处可以找到该神庙。
321.place_en: Located inside the cave hidden behind the waterfall.
321.note_zh: 本神庙有诸多水与火的互动解谜，将通电的铁球拿出，通过通天术来到上层位置即可完成神庙，详情可点击左下角查看攻略。
321.note_en: Solve interactions between water, fire, and electricity. Pull out electrified iron spheres, use ice to neutralize lava, and use Ascend to reach the upper gate.
321.chest_zh: 通过带电的水池后就能找到宝箱，将冰块放到角落处的高台旁边，爬上冰块拿到宝箱，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
321.chest_en: Located in an alcove past the electrified pool. Stack ice blocks beneath the ledge, climb up, and open the chest for a Strong Zonaite Shield.

314.place_zh: 在山坳中可以找到该神庙。
314.note_zh: 该神庙的机关的重点是通过石板与齿轮的配合来向上移动即可，注意使用通天术。
314.note_en: Attach stone poles to interlock turning cogs, and use logs to bridge rotating mechanisms and ascend with Ascend.
314.chest_zh: 通过双齿轮房间后可直接拿起石柱将左边的宝箱捅下来，打开可获得魔像之刚弓。
314.chest_en: In the room with dual cogs, use Ultrahand to grab a long pole and knock down the chest on the left wall to obtain a Mighty Construct Bow.

310.place_zh: 在山丘半腰处的平台上可以找到该神庙。
310.place_en: Located on a terrace on the hillside.
310.note_zh: 前往上层将石球通过滑轨，滑到坑中即可完成神庙。
310.note_en: Drive Zonai Stakes into walls to halt rolling boulders, create footholds, and guide the stone sphere into the goal pit.
310.chest_zh: 位于起始点附近，在中层平台利用气流飞到空中向后飞到宝箱位置即可，
310.chest_en: Located on a high platform near the starting area. Ride the wind updraft on the middle tier and glide backward to reach the chest with Arrows x5.

304.place_zh: 初始台地北侧下方山脚可以找到一个洞窟，破坏入口处的岩石后深入洞窟就能找到神庙。
304.place_en: Find a cave entrance at the foot of the cliff north of the Great Plateau. Break through the cracked rocks to reach the shrine.
304.note_zh: 进入神庙后我们可以看到地面上有很多坑，前方的台子上摆着四个小石球，抬头可以看到天花板上有圆形的图案，将石球放入正对图案下方的坑中即可。
304.note_en: Look at the ceiling to observe four glowing circular constellations. Place the four small stone spheres into the floor recesses matching the ceiling map.
304.chest_zh: 在终点前左侧的某块地板可以搬开，随后将旁边的小石球放入坑中即可打开栅栏门拿到宝箱，打开可获得生命药。
304.chest_en: Lift a loose wooden floorboard on the left before the altar, then place a stone sphere in the revealed hole to unlock a chest with a Hearty Elixir.

298.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 初等
298.place_zh: 在树林中可以找到该神庙。
298.note_zh: 该神庙为禁止使用自带武器和道具的孑然一身战斗，在入口右侧可以拿到武器，该神庙的敌人较为简单，打败敌人完成神庙。
298.note_en: Proving Grounds beginner combat trial. Pick up weapons on the right at the entrance and defeat all Soldier Constructs.
298.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得弹簧盾。
298.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Spring Shield.

293.place_zh: 在平原上可以找到该神庙。
293.note_zh: 该神庙为战斗技巧练习神庙，投掷武器并名中敌人即可进入下一环节。
293.note_en: Combat Training shrine focused on throwing weapons. Hold R and aim to throw weapons directly at the Construct's head to pass the trial.
293.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开宝箱可获得左纳尼乌姆之枪
293.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Zonaite Spear.

288.place_zh: 在山丘的下方可以找到该神庙。
288.place_en: Located at the foot of the hill.
288.note_zh: 该神庙解谜要素不多，不断将原木举起放下，并使用倒转能力，来到上层后乘坐小船即可顺利到达终点。
288.note_en: Attach logs end-to-end to build bridges and ramps. Cast Recall on lifted logs or build a motorized log raft to cross water to the altar.
288.chest_zh: 位于上层区域的小平台上，乘坐小船就能轻松抵达，打开宝箱可获得刺盾。
288.chest_en: Located on a small platform on the upper water channel. Steer the raft over to open the chest and obtain a Spiked Shield.

280.place_zh: 在瞭望塔旁边的草地上可以找到该神庙。
280.place_en: Located on the grassy field next to the Skyview Tower.
280.note_zh: 该神庙解谜较难，需要将石球打到靶子上，首先将场地中机器旁边的桩插在机关上，然后再在桩上安装一个柱，通过机关来敲打石球命中靶子即可，详情可点击左下角查看攻略。
280.note_en: Attach Zonai Stakes to the floor switch, attach a pole to make a baseball flipper bat, and hit the switch as the rolling ball approaches to launch it into the bullseye target.
280.chest_zh: 位于右边房间，将石球命中右边靶子即可解锁房间，打开宝箱可获得精力药。
280.chest_en: Hit the optional second target on the right side to open the locked door to a chest with an Energizing Elixir.

274.place_zh: 在草原中的一个废弃广场上可以找到该神庙。
274.place_en: Located in an abandoned square in the grassy field.
274.note_zh: 要注意板车的行动轨迹，注意机关情况来改变板车的形态即可。
274.note_en: Ride motorized wheeled carts along tracks. Use Ultrahand to adjust wheels, switch tracks, and drive directly into the goal.
274.chest_zh: 进入神庙后可以使用究极手来打乱板车的行驶线路从而拿到宝箱。
274.chest_en: Use Ultrahand to catch a moving wheeled cart on the lower track and retrieve the chest mounted on it to obtain Arrows x5.

267.place_zh: 在监视堡垒南方草原上巨大的空岛碎片旁可以找到该神庙。
267.place_en: Located beside a huge fallen sky island ruin south of Lookout Landing.
267.note_zh: 本神庙使用磁铁能力移动石块是重点，把石块以合适的角度 放入正确的位置即可。
267.note_en: Rotate 3D X-shaped and L-shaped stone blocks through specially shaped wall holes, then use them as stairs to reach the altar.
267.chest_en: Rotate the shape into the side room's wall cutout, climb inside, and open the chest to obtain a Hasty Elixir.

253.place_zh: 在丘陵的半山腰处可以找到该神庙。
253.place_en: Located halfway up the hill slope.
253.note_zh: 风扇是本神庙的主要工具，根据使用场景来改变风扇的用法即可。
253.note_en: Use Zonai Fans to propel rafts across water, rotate elevator arms, and create vertical updrafts to paraglide upward.
253.chest_zh: 位于上层的一个平台中，使用通天术或另一个风扇吹风都可以到达上层平台打开宝箱，打开可获得蛋白石。
253.chest_en: Located on a high wall ledge on the second level. Attach a fan blowing upward or use Ascend to reach the chest containing an Opal.

245.place_zh: 在中央广场遗迹中可以找到该神庙。
245.place_en: Located in the Central Square ruins.
245.note_zh: 该神庙为战斗技巧教学神庙，可以在战斗教学中多使用横跳躲避敌人的劈砍攻击，随后后空翻躲避敌人的横扫攻击，结束所有的技巧教学后即可完成前往神庙终点。
245.note_en: Combat Training shrine. Practice side hops to dodge vertical strikes, backflips to dodge horizontal sweeps, and shield parries to defeat the trainer.
245.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，含有左纳尼乌姆之剑。
245.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Zonaite Sword.

243.trial_zh: 战斗的教导 投掷的精髓
243.place_zh: 在建筑残骸旁的草地上可以找到该神庙。
243.place_en: Located on the grass near ruined stone architecture.
243.note_zh: 该神庙为战斗技巧练习神庙，在大厅中拿到火焰果后将其投掷向高台上的敌人，命中敌人一次后敌人会开始在高台上左右移动，等到其停止移动后再透支一次火焰果即可完成该神庙。
243.note_en: Combat Training shrine focused on throwing materials. Pick Fire Fruit from bushes, hold R and Up on D-pad, and throw Fire Fruit at the Construct on the platform.
243.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点处，打开宝箱可获得炸弹花X3。
243.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain Bomb Flowers x3.

239.place_zh: 在海拉鲁城堡北面的平台上可以找到该神庙。
239.place_en: Located on the terrace north of Hyrule Castle.
239.note_zh: 本神庙有大量需要使用石板来解谜的场景，将石板改变为适合机关要求的样子即可。
239.note_en: Assemble stone slabs into inverted L-brackets and T-frames, place them onto wall pegs to create overhangs, and use Ascend beneath them.
239.chest_zh: 位置在上层平台处，来到上层平台后先站在地面的尖刺旁将石板尽可能的举高再放下，跳到石板上使用倒转即可来到上层拿到宝箱。打开可获得魔法杖。
239.chest_en: On the upper level, raise a stone slab high near the spikes, lower it, stand underneath, and cast Recall to reach the chest with a Magic Rod.

235.place_zh: 在河岸边的山地上可以找到该神庙。
235.place_en: Located on elevated ground beside the riverbank.
235.note_zh: 需要注意刚进入神庙的火炬都需要点燃，后面需要使用小石子进行解谜，将小石子放到第一个坑后拿起再放到第二个坑后，在两个门中间使用倒转让小石球再次回到第一个坑中即可完成该神庙。
235.note_en: Light torches with fire. Put a small stone sphere into the first hole to open the inner gate, retrieve it, place it in the second hole, walk between the gates, and cast Recall on the sphere to reopen the outer door.
235.chest_zh: 位于神庙起始点的右侧，含有魔像之刚弓，使用火把点燃宝箱下方的树叶即可。
235.chest_en: Located to the right of the starting area. Burn the dried leaves underneath with a torch to drop the chest containing a Mighty Construct Bow.

233.place_zh: 在巨大的树桩内部可以找到该神庙。
233.place_en: Located inside a giant hollow tree stump.
233.note_zh: 进入神庙后先将钢板搭成一个坡道，随后打击启动放出一个石球，使石头通过坡道飞入远处的坑中打开前进的道路，随后将短钢板拆下和长钢板组合成一个有角度的坡道，并将其伸出平台边缘一点放好，随后启动机关，石球在击落钢板的同时可以飞到远处的坑中，前往终点完成神庙。
233.note_en: Assemble ramps with metal plates to launch rolling iron balls across gaps into floor switches.
233.chest_zh: 位于第二个房间的右侧，使用石板搭桥即可拿到，打开后可获得左纳尼乌姆之硬盾。
233.chest_en: Located on the right side of the second chamber. Build a flat bridge with metal plates to reach the chest containing a Strong Zonaite Shield.

229.place_zh: 在克洛格森林中间广场西南角，与玛卡玛喀交谈解锁玛卡玛喀的珍藏地点，随后来到克洛格森林上方的空岛，从空岛向着下方的神庙俯冲，落地后即可进入该神庙。
229.place_en: Speak with Maca in the southwest corner of the Korok Forest clearing. Go to the sky island above Korok Forest and skydive through the fog to land right at the shrine.
229.note_zh: 本神庙没有解谜元素，可以直接完成。
229.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
229.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得魔像之刚弓。
229.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Construct Bow.

227.place_zh: 在克洛格森林中央广场西北角与【阿兹基】交谈，随后沿着前方的小路前进，跟着路边的潜行草前进，途中会遭遇许多敌人，将其全部消灭即可，在前方即可找到该神庙。
227.place_en: Speak with Agik in the northwest of Korok Forest, then follow the trail of Blue Nightshade. Clear enemies along the path to find the shrine.
227.note_zh: 该神庙需要神庙水晶，跟随指引击败一只岩石巨人后拿到神庙水晶即可。
227.note_en: Defeat the nearby Stone Talus to claim the shrine crystal, then carry it back to activate the shrine.
227.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得钻石。
227.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

216.place_zh: 在克洛格森林中央广场东侧找到两个豌豆荚，沿着中间的小路前进。在小路前方就可以直接看到神庙水晶，与旁边的达秘达米交谈得知我们需要5个金苹果来换，如果没有金苹果就需要继续深入森林，穿过沼泽后可以找到两颗金苹果树，将金苹果交给达秘达米后拿到水晶，将其带至神庙所在位置打开神庙。
216.place_en: Head east from Korok Forest along the pea-pod path to find Damia. Trade 5 Golden Apples to obtain the shrine crystal, then carry it to the shrine.
216.note_zh: 建议提前准备好五个金苹果来换取水晶，神庙没有解谜。
216.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
216.chest_zh: 左纳尼乌姆之刚剑，位于神庙终点。
216.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Zonaite Sword.

208.place_zh: 在山坳中可以找到该神庙。
208.note_zh: 该神庙可以直接利用倒转能力通过箱子刚刚的运动轨迹直接来到终点。
208.note_en: Ride falling and moving stone blocks by casting Recall on them to reverse their trajectory upward to reach the altar.
208.chest_zh: 在第二个箱子后面，打开后可获得左纳尼乌姆之盾。
208.chest_en: Located behind the second moving block. Drop down to the alcove to open the chest and obtain a Zonaite Shield.

204.place_zh: 在海拉鲁大森林北部的山地中可以找到神庙。
204.place_en: Located in the mountainous terrain north of the Great Hyrule Forest.
204.note_zh: 该神庙的解谜都集中在开始的齿轮处，先对前方的齿轮使用倒转，让球从右侧掉入坑中，在前方用究极手抓住摇杆使左侧的大齿轮逆时针转动，随后跳至齿轮上使用倒转进入地下的房间，打开宝箱后使用通天术即可完成神庙。
204.note_en: Cast Recall on the entrance gear to let the ball drop into the right pit. In the main room, manually turn the giant gear counter-clockwise, stand on a cog, and cast Recall to access the lower room.
204.chest_zh: 打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之大剑。
204.chest_en: Located in the lower chamber beneath the giant gear. Open the chest to obtain a Zonaite Longsword.

196.place_zh: 在山脚下可以找到一个入口处带有骷髅装饰的洞窟，消灭沿途遭遇的敌人并不断深入洞窟，在洞窟深处可以找到该神庙。
196.place_en: Find a cave entrance marked with a skull ornament at the base of the mountain. Defeat enemies as you advance deep inside to find the shrine.
196.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
196.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
196.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得大容量电池。
196.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Big Battery.

191.place_zh: 在地图最北边的山脚空地上可以找到该神庙。
191.place_en: Located in an open clearing at the foot of the northernmost mountains.
191.note_zh: 该神庙需要重复的向上弹射再向下俯冲，把握时机启动机关让石球落至其上即可完成该神庙。
191.note_en: Step on the launch mechanism to shoot yourself into the air, dive down, and strike the floor target switch right as the ball falls into alignment.
191.chest_zh: 悬挂在向上的通道中，可以下落的时候使用林克时间将其射下来，打开宝箱后可获得大的左纳乌能源。
191.chest_en: Hanging in the vertical launch shaft. Shoot the rope with an arrow during mid-air bullet time to drop the chest containing a Large Zonai Charge.

182.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 追踪
182.place_zh: 在峡谷中可以找到该神庙。
182.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用自带装备的孑然一身战，消灭所有敌人即可。
182.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Activate Homing Carts and attach spike balls and flame emitters to let automated carts wipe out the enemy Constructs.
182.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点处，打开可获得上等队长矛。
182.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Captain III Spear.

175.place_zh: 神庙本体较为显眼，前往标点位置即可。
175.place_en: Easily spotted at the marked location near Lake Darman in Eldin.
175.note_zh: 在前往该神庙前建议前往鼓隆城购买两件耐火防具，进入盖洛湖旁的洞窟中，进入山洞消灭敌人后用炸弹等道具破坏岩石前进，在岔路口向左走，在左侧山洞中的高台上可以找到神庙水晶。
175.note_en: Wear Flamebreaker armor. Enter the cave by Lake Darman, destroy cracked rocks, take the left path, and defeat the Igneo Talus to retrieve the shrine crystal.
175.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
175.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Strong Zonaite Shield.

174.place_zh: 在山顶可以找到该神庙。
174.place_en: Located on the mountain peak overlooking the volcano.
174.note_zh: 将两个风扇安装在中间的转轮上，最好放在一条支线的两端且方向相反，随后启动风扇是转轮转动，同时将周围的六个小风车全部吹动即可完成该神庙。
174.note_en: Attach two Zonai Fans in opposing directions on the central spinning wheel. Activate them to rotate the wheel rapidly and spin all six pinwheels at once.
174.chest_zh: 位于神庙上空的一个高台，打开后可获得魔像之刚弓。
174.chest_en: Located on a high ledge above the spinning wheel. Glide from the updrafts to reach the chest with a Mighty Construct Bow.

159.place_zh: 在鼓隆城入口旁边的山上可以找到该神庙。
159.place_en: Located on the mountain next to the entrance of Goron City.
159.note_zh: 该神庙唯一需要注意的点是终点前需要将足够数量的小石子推到坑中。
159.note_en: Fuse wheeled carts together into an extendable bridge over lava. In the final room, use the bulldozer cart to push small stone balls into the giant recess.
159.chest_zh: 宝箱位于终点附近，打开可获得魔像之强弓。
159.chest_en: Located on a high ledge near the goal. Extend the wheeled carts into a tall ramp to reach the chest containing a Strong Construct Bow.

156.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 倒放
156.place_zh: 首先使用阿沅的能力炸开洞窟入口处的可口岩并进入山洞，进入山洞后再次打破可口岩继续深入洞窟，在山洞内部可以找到该神庙，打破周围的岩石后即可进入神庙。
156.place_en: Use Yunobo's charge ability to smash Marbled Rock into the cave, destroy interior rocks, and reveal the shrine.
156.note_zh: 该神庙为孑然一身战，没有什么难点将所有敌人全部消灭即可完成该神庙。
156.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Sneak through the cavern and defeat all Soldier Constructs.
156.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得魔法杖。
156.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Rod.

138.place_zh: 首先来到鼓隆城北边的矿车站台处，随后将矿车放在站台右侧的轨道上并搭乘矿车前进，进入最前方的山洞中，进入蟹蟹岛坑道后继续搭乘矿车前进，到达最深处后即可发现神庙。
138.place_en: Take a minecart from the station north of Goron City along the right rail. Ride deep into Isle of Rabac Gallery tunnel to discover the shrine.
138.note_zh: 洞窟内结构较为复杂可以点击左下角的查看攻略以获得更为详细的路线，该神庙本身没有解谜要素。
138.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
138.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得魔法长杖。
138.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Staff.

130.place_zh: 来到鼓隆城北边的矿车站台，来到鼓隆城北边的矿车站台，来到高处后从右边的坡道继续向上，抵达死亡之山西边作业场所，搭乘矿车沿着左侧的轨道前进，在上方的中转平台下面可以找到该神庙。
130.place_en: Ride the minecart from northern Goron City upward to West Restaurant Basin, then ride the left rail to the lower transfer platform to find the shrine.
130.note_zh: 该神庙解谜要素不多，前半部分使用小车度过岩浆，后面直接骑乘滑翔机飞到终点即可。
130.note_en: Drive four-wheeled lava carts across lava pools, then pilot a motorized glider through the open volcanic chamber straight to the altar.
130.chest_zh: 位于石球坑附近的栅栏门房间，打开可获得魔像之刚弓。
130.chest_en: Located in a barred room near the ball pit. Use Ultrahand to retrieve the ball and drop it into the hole to open the door to a Mighty Construct Bow.

126.place_zh: 在矿山半山腰的平台上可以找到该神庙。
126.place_en: Located on a terrace halfway up Death Mountain.
126.note_zh: 破坏矿山下的岩石进入山洞，进入山洞后搭乘矿车前进，再前方击败一只熔岩巨人后拿到水晶，再通过矿车将水晶运出山洞即可。
126.note_en: Smash rocks beneath the mine to enter the cave, ride a minecart forward, defeat the Igneo Talus to obtain the crystal, and ride the cart back to the shrine.
126.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得大容量电池。
126.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Big Battery.

122.place_zh: 在山坳中可以找到该神庙。
122.note_zh: 使用倒转将塔三层的石头平台拼接成一列，使用通天术来到上层后先从有缺口的位置跳下，打开塔中间层的宝箱后再回到上层完成该神庙。
122.note_en: Cast Recall on the turning tiers of the pillar to align their climbing ridges, then use Ascend beneath the openings to climb to the top.
122.chest_zh: 位于塔中间层，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之强大剑。
122.chest_en: Located on the middle tier inside the hollow pillar. Drop down from the top opening to grab the chest containing a Mighty Zonaite Longsword.

120.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 粉碎
120.place_zh: 在死亡之山北边的湿地区域可以找到该神庙。
120.place_en: Located in the wetland area north of Death Mountain.
120.note_zh: 该神庙为孑然一身之战神庙，打败所有的敌人即可完成。
120.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Fuse spiked balls to two-handed clubs to smash Construct armor and defeat all enemies.
120.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开宝箱可获得中等队长利刃。
120.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Captain II Blade.

118.place_zh: 在山崖下的草地上可以找到该神庙。
118.place_en: Located on the grassy terrain beneath the cliff.
118.note_zh: 进入神庙后先来到左侧房间，将大砖块和上方的杆链接，随后用究极手将其高高抬起。当前方的坑开始向右移动，并且下图中标记出的平台边框即将与球平齐时松手，将其放入坑中，重复此步骤即可完成该神庙。
118.note_en: Attach a heavy iron cube to the swinging arm to create a giant pendulum hammer. Time your swing release to launch the iron sphere into the target.
118.chest_zh: 位于起始点左边的栅栏房间，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之刚大剑。
118.chest_en: Located in the barred room left of the entrance. Hit the secondary target to unlock the door and obtain a Mighty Zonaite Longsword.

117.place_zh: 进入洛美岛遗迹后沿着地面上的橡子移动，在遗迹的最深处即可找到该神庙。
117.place_en: Enter Lomei Labyrinth Island and follow the acorn markers on the ground to the deepest chamber.
117.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
117.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
117.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开后可获得大的左纳乌能源。
117.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

115.place_zh: 在地图东北角的海边可以找到该神庙。
115.place_en: Located on the seashore at the northeast corner of the map.
115.note_zh: 该神庙内有着诸多黄球，将黄球与各种东西结合即可顺利完成本神庙。
115.note_en: Attach yellow buoyant orbs to wooden rafts to create floating ferries that navigate across water channels.
115.chest_zh: 悬挂在河水的左边，可以将两个球和石板组合在一起，并将其伸到前方的宝箱下面来获取，打开可获得魔法大杖。
115.chest_en: Hanging from a rope on the left side of the river. Fuse two yellow orbs to a stone slab, extend it under the chest, and cut the rope to obtain a Magic Scepter.

113.place_zh: 在山上的树林中可以找到该神庙。
113.place_en: Located in the woods atop the mountain in Akkala.
113.note_zh: 将石柱的结构破坏后，将最上方的石球放入坑中即可完成神庙。
113.note_en: Carefully pull out horizontal iron rods from the Jenga-style tower without causing the top stone ball to tumble off, then drop the ball into the pit.
113.chest_zh: 位于石柱内部，将三根铁柱全部抽出后可以拿到宝箱，打开后可获得大的左纳尼乌姆。
113.chest_en: Inside the tower structure. Carefully extract all three blocking rods to reach the chest containing Large Zonaite.

111.trial_zh: 战斗的教导 偷袭的精髓
111.place_zh: 在草原上可以找到该神庙。
111.place_en: Located on the open plains of Akkala.
111.note_zh: 该神庙为潜行教学神庙，我们需要按下左摇杆蹲下，悄悄从背后接近敌人进行偷袭即可。
111.note_en: Combat Training shrine for sneakstrikes. Press the left stick to crouch, quietly sneak up behind the enemy Construct, and press Y to perform a Sneakstrike.
111.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点处，打开后可获得潜行药。
111.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Sneaky Elixir.

105.place_zh: 在山顶的遗迹中可以找到该神庙。
105.place_en: Located among the ruins atop the mountain peak.
105.note_zh: 该神庙的解谜要素集中在一个大笼子中，通过其缺口即可完成解谜。
105.note_en: The puzzle revolves around a giant rotating cage. Strike the crystal pillar to rotate the cage and navigate through opening gaps to reach the top.
105.chest_zh: 位于大笼子内，打开可获得左纳乌姆之硬盾。
105.chest_en: Located inside the rotating cage. Turn the cage so the opening aligns with the chest to obtain a Strong Zonaite Shield.

104.place_zh: 在海边螺旋形状的岛中可以找到该神庙。
104.place_en: Located in the center of Rist Peninsula's spiral island in Akkala.
104.note_zh: 将所有的火龙头安装到风扇中，启动火龙头后再用钢板通电即可完成该神庙。
104.note_en: Attach flame emitters to the spinning propeller blades, activate them, and complete the circuit with metal plates to ignite all torches simultaneously.
104.chest_zh: 位于右前方的高台，打开后可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
104.chest_en: Located on an elevated platform on the right. Ride the updraft created by the flames to reach the chest with a Strong Zonaite Shield.

103.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 操纵
103.place_zh: 在山顶的草地上可以找到该神庙。
103.place_en: Located on the grassy summit of the mountain.
103.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用自带装备的孑然一身战，消灭所有敌人即可。
103.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Hop onto the motorized assault vehicles and run over Soldier Constructs across the arena.
103.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开宝箱可获得魔法杖。
103.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Rod.

102.place_zh: 前往标注位置即可，在瀑布下可以找到该神庙。
102.place_en: Located under the waterfall at the marked location.
102.note_zh: 该神庙需要自行搭建水或空的运输工具，建议提前准备好胶囊，搭乘交通工具跟随指引来到一始村与村民交谈，花费50卢比买下水晶，将水晶带至神庙处即可打开该神庙。
102.note_en: Build a boat or flying machine to reach Tarrey Town. Speak with Hagie, purchase the shrine crystal for 50 Rupees, and transport it down to the shrine.
102.chest_zh: 位于宝箱终点处，打开宝箱可获得钻石。
102.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

100.place_zh: 在米法公园旁边可以找到该神庙，首先需要用水清理神庙入口前的淤泥才能进入神庙。
100.place_en: Located next to Mipha Court on Ploymus Mountain. Clear away the sludge blocking the entrance using water or Splash Fruit.
100.note_zh: 该神庙注意利用浮空的石块使用通天术即可，解谜难度较低。
100.note_en: Use Hover Stones to create stepping stones and floating platforms, then use Ascend beneath them to climb up to the altar.
100.chest_zh: 位于上层区域的凹槽中，打开可获得木箭x5。
100.chest_en: Located in an alcove on the upper ledge. Place a Hover Stone under the opening and Ascend to reach the chest with Arrows x5.

99.place_zh: 在卓拉领地的入口下方可以找到该神庙。
99.place_en: Located underneath the entrance bridge to Zora's Domain.
99.note_zh: 该神庙需要多注意电池，通过在固定位置给电池充电到达电梯完成本神庙。
99.note_en: Attach wooden boards to waterwheels to generate hydroelectric power, charge the portable battery, and power the elevator to reach the altar.
99.chest_zh: 宝箱位于水池对面的栅栏房间内，带着电池来到此区域，先将下方的两个铁球离得尽可能近。同时前后挪动一下水中的石板，将有电的电池放在底座上打开栅栏门，使用倒转跟随石板前进，拿到前方房间中的宝箱，打开宝箱后可获得蛋白石。
99.chest_en: Located in a barred room across the pool. Connect the submerged iron balls to complete the circuit, power the door, and open the chest for an Opal.

98.place_zh: 来到标注位置，进入山脚下的山洞中，利用木板、风扇和操纵杆做成一艘简易小船，带着水晶穿过池塘，将水晶带至神庙处即可打开该神庙。
98.place_en: Enter the cave at the base of the mountain at the marked location. Build a motorized raft with boards, fans, and a steering stick to carry the crystal across the underground pond.
98.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
98.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
98.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得大的左纳乌能源。
98.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

97.place_zh: 来到标点处，从半岛最南边的废墟中进入洞窟，进入洞窟后穿过池塘，在洞窟最深处可以找到该神庙。
97.place_en: Enter the cave through the ruins at the southern tip of the peninsula. Swim across the flooded chamber to find the shrine deep inside.
97.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
97.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
97.chest_zh: 处于终点处，打开可获得钻石。
97.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

96.place_zh: 在山崖上的建筑残骸下可以找到该神庙。
96.place_en: Located beneath the architectural ruins on the cliffside.
96.note_zh: 该神庙解谜要素较为简单，将小石球放到坑中即可完成解谜，最后使用滑翔翼飞到终点地下，使用通天术即可。
96.note_en: Use Fans and Wings on rails to transport small stone spheres into floor switches, then glide a Wing to the altar ledge.
96.chest_zh: 位于阶梯式建筑的最高处，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之强枪。
96.chest_en: Located at the highest point of the tiered ruins. Ride a fan-propelled Wing upward to reach the chest containing a Strong Zonaite Spear.

95.place_zh: 来到标注位置，从山顶的骷髅中进入洞窟，在洞窟中可以找到该神庙。
95.place_en: Enter the cave through the giant skull formation atop the mountain to find the shrine deep within.
95.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
95.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
95.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得钻石。
95.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

94.place_zh: 在池塘边可以找到该神庙。
94.place_en: Located beside the pond on Lanayru Wetlands.
94.note_zh: 用究极手将水中的黄球压入水下，再松开后即可使黄球命中上方的靶子，继续前进将黄色的板竖起来压入水中再松开即可，在前方将黄球压入水中，使其上升时砸中平台打飞木板使平台落下，跳到平台上使用倒转来到上层，前往终点完成该神庙。
94.note_en: Push buoyant yellow spheres deep underwater with Ultrahand, then release them to launch upward and hit targets on the ceiling.
94.chest_zh: 位于左侧的水底，直接用究极手拿上来即可，打开后可获得魔像之强弓。
94.chest_en: Submerged at the bottom of the left pool. Lift it out using Ultrahand to obtain a Strong Construct Bow.

93.place_zh: 在草地中的树林间可以找到该神庙。
93.place_en: Located within the forest trees on the grassy plain.
93.note_zh: 该神庙需要玩家将位于起始点的石球运输到终点的坑中即可完成神庙，详情可点击左下角的查看攻略。
93.note_en: Transport the large stone sphere across tracks, conveyor belts, and rafts powered by paddlewheels to place it in the goal pit.
93.chest_zh: 位于水池中，使用究极手将其拿上来打开，打开后可获得左纳尼乌姆之强剑。
93.chest_en: Submerged in the water channel. Pull it out using Ultrahand to open it and obtain a Strong Zonaite Sword.

92.place_zh: 在山顶可以直接找到该神庙。
92.place_en: Located right at the summit of the hill.
92.note_zh: 该神庙需要不断使用弹簧前往上层，集齐三个弹簧后即可弹到最上层的终点，详细教程可点击左下角的查看攻略。
92.note_en: Use Zonai Springs to launch yourself and stone spheres to higher terraces. Stack three springs together to launch to the highest altar tier.
92.chest_zh: 位于中间层，在拿到两个弹簧后可以到达宝箱位置，打开后可获得潜行药。
92.chest_en: Located on the intermediate tier. Launch yourself horizontally with a spring to land beside the chest containing a Sneaky Elixir.

91.place_zh: 在卡卡利科村旁边的山地上可以找到该神庙。
91.place_en: Located on the hills right next to Kakariko Village.
91.note_zh: 注意安装不倒翁，勤用通天术即可轻松完成该神庙。
91.note_en: Attach Zonai Stabilizers to iron plates to create upright standing ladders and catapult ramps, then use Ascend to climb up.
91.chest_zh: 位于上层区域的平台中，打开宝箱可获得妖精回力水。
91.chest_en: Located on an elevated wall platform in the middle area. Erect a Stabilizer plate against the wall to reach the chest containing Fairy Tonic.

90.place_zh: 在河三岔口旁的遗迹中可以找到该神庙。
90.place_en: Located among ruins by the river junction.
90.note_zh: 该神庙需要找到水星，摧毁旁边的岩石后可以找到一个滑翔翼，配合山洞中的零件可以组装成一架飞机将水晶运会神庙，该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
90.note_en: Retrieve the crystal, destroy rocks to find a Wing, and assemble a plane with cave parts to fly the crystal back to the shrine.
90.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点处，打开可获得大容量电池。
90.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Big Battery.

89.place_zh: 进入山脚下的大山洞，进入山脚下的大山洞，来到洞窟最深处可以见到一个被水环绕的小岛，来到洞窟最深处可以见到一个被水环绕的小岛，进入内部即可找到神庙。
89.place_en: Enter the large cavern at the foot of the mountain and follow the water channel to a secluded underground island where the shrine rests.
89.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
89.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
89.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开宝箱后可获得生命药。
89.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Hearty Elixir.

88.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 上升
88.place_zh: 首先来到下图所示的空岛上，与纹章互动开启挑战，利用踩盾滑行滑下前方的坡道穿过绿色圆圈，随后跟随蓝色光点的指引前往地面指定位置，跟随蓝色光点的指引前往地面指定位置，抵达终点后即可使神庙现形，进入神庙即可。
88.place_en: Interact with the terminal on Mount Lanayru Sky Island, shield-surf down the snowy slope through all green rings, and follow the blue beam to reveal the shrine on the surface.
88.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用自带装备的孑然一身战，消灭所有敌人即可。
88.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Ride hot-air balloons and gliders upward to defeat all enemy Constructs.
88.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点处，打开可获得特等兵队矛。
88.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Soldier IV Spear.

87.place_zh: 在雪山半山腰的平台上可以找到该神庙。
87.place_en: Located on a terrace halfway up Mount Lanayru.
87.note_zh: 该神庙解谜要素简单，只需要找好地方使用通天术到达终点即可。
87.note_en: Move stone blocks along ceiling grooves to create stepping stones and alignment points for Ascend to reach the altar.
87.chest_zh: 位于长平台上，打开可获得魔法长杖。
87.chest_en: Located on a long suspended platform. Position a block beneath the overhang and use Ascend to obtain a Magic Staff.

86.trial_zh: 战斗的指导 盾的精髓
86.place_zh: 在河边的山腰处可以找到该神庙。
86.place_en: Located on the hillside by the river.
86.note_zh: 该神庙的内容为盾牌练习，使用盾牌反弹敌人的远程攻击即可。
86.note_en: Combat Training shrine for shield parrying. Hold ZL to raise your shield and press A right as an enemy projectile approaches to deflect it back.
86.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
86.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Strong Zonaite Shield.

85.place_zh: 到达标点位置后与管家魔像交谈得知需要3把由水而生的钥匙，来到附近的河边制造冰板。将做好的三个冰板组合带回管家处。拆下一个冰板调整放到第一个凹槽中。用火焰点燃旁边的篝火，随后用火来使冰板不断缩小，直至冰板大小可以放入剩余的两个凹槽中，当三个凹槽全部放入冰板即可找到神庙。
85.place_en: Speak with the Steward Construct at the marked location. Form three ice slabs from the river, melt two over the campfire until they fit into the smaller slots, and insert all three into the stone indentations to reveal the shrine.
85.note_zh: 神庙本身没有解谜要素，注意可以多做几个冰板以防止不够。
85.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
85.chest_zh: 位于终点位置，打开可获大容量电池。
85.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Big Battery.

82.place_zh: 来到标点位置，进入海边的山洞，在山洞内部可以找到该神庙，但我们需要先从左侧的洞进入下层，破坏洞窟顶部莱克旁边的岩石，回去后发现神庙四周的水被排干即可。
82.place_en: Enter the seaside cave at the marked location. Drop into the lower cavern and destroy the cracked rocks by the Like Like to drain the water around the shrine.
82.note_zh: 进入神庙后先打开开关，让右侧的装置向前动，来到右侧使用通天术到达上层即可打开宝箱，回到地面打击开关使装置恢复正常，对滚落石球使用倒转，进行第三次打击开关把球弄到坑中打开前进的道路即可。
82.note_en: Hit the switch to advance the mechanism, use Ascend to reach the chest, return down and hit the switch again, then cast Recall on the rolling ball to guide it into the pit.
82.chest_zh: 打开可获得大的左纳乌能源
82.chest_en: Located on the upper right platform. Use Ascend after the mechanism moves forward to reach the chest with a Large Zonai Charge.

81.place_zh: 在哈特诺村西南边的山上可以找到该神庙。
81.place_en: Located on the hills southwest of Hateno Village.
81.note_zh: 进入神庙后先来到下层，将石球运输到终点前的石坑即可。
81.note_en: Head to the lower room and attach metal scoops to the rotating water wheel to scoop up small stone spheres and dump them into the goal hopper.
81.chest_zh: 位于石球堆中，打开宝箱可获得左纳尼乌姆之强大剑。
81.chest_en: Buried in the pile of stone spheres on the lower level. Pull it out using Ultrahand to obtain a Mighty Zonaite Longsword.

80.place_zh: 在研究所旁边的山坳中破坏岩石进入洞窟，在洞窟内部可以找到该神庙。
80.place_en: Smash cracked rocks in the mountain hollow next to the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab to access the cave where the shrine resides.
80.note_zh: 在洞窟内部可以找到该神庙。
80.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
80.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得魔法大杖。
80.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Scepter.

79.place_zh: 在靠近山丘顶部的位置可以找到该神庙。
79.place_en: Located near the summit of the hill.
79.note_zh: 该神庙将石板组合成适合的形态就能顺利到达终点，解谜较为简单，详情可点击左下角查看攻略。
79.note_en: Connect stone slabs into U-shapes and interlocking grooved sleds that slide securely along rail tracks over the abyss.
79.chest_zh: 宝箱位于神庙第二个房间，只需要把石板放到中间镂空地带即可抵达，打开可获得防滑药。
79.chest_en: Located in the second puzzle chamber. Bridge the middle gap with a 3-slab platform to reach the chest containing a Sticky Elixir.

72.place_zh: 来到标点位置，与海滩边的格玛纳交谈得知岛上有三处怪物据点，随后根据任务指引将三处据点中的怪物全部消灭，返回与格玛纳交谈后，来到岛的顶部滑翔至岛的背面可以发现一个巨大的山洞，滑翔至深处的山洞中即可找到该神庙，如果不进行任务直接来到此处，神庙所在山洞的大门是关闭的。
72.place_en: Speak with Sesami on Eventide Island to get the quest to clear three pirate monster camps. Defeat all pirates, speak with Sesami, and glide into the giant cave on the island's back side to find the shrine.
72.note_zh: 该神庙必须要完成格玛纳的任务才能开启，神庙本身无解谜要素。
72.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
72.chest_zh: 位于终点，打开后可获得红宝石。
72.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Ruby.

71.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 水流
71.place_zh: 在山脚下的草地上可以找到该神庙。
71.place_en: Located on the grassy terrain at the base of the hill near Palmorae Beach.
71.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用自带装备的孑然一身战，将所有敌人消灭即可。
71.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Use the flowing water current and raft to engage Soldier Constructs.
71.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开宝箱可获得上等队长利刃。
71.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Captain III Blade.

69.place_zh: 首先进入湖边山下的洞窟中，破坏洞窟中的藤蔓继续前进，经过两只电击莱克后，将一块木板放入钟乳石下方后站在木板上使用通天术向上，经过两只岩石莱克后在前方山洞最深处可以找到该神庙。
69.place_en: Enter the cave beneath the mountain by the lake. Cut through vines past the Shock Likes, place a board under the stalactite, and use Ascend to reach the upper tunnel past the Rock Likes.
69.note_zh: 神庙本身没有解谜，但是想找到神庙较为麻烦。
69.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
69.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点位置，打开后可获得大容量电池。
69.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Big Battery.

1494.place_en: Cave entrance leading into the Shrine of Resurrection on the Great Plateau.
1494.note_en: Connects to the Shrine of Resurrection, featuring a recovery pool and the Yiga Clan hideout.

2887.place_en: Inside the Shrine of Resurrection cave on the Great Plateau.
2887.note_en: Defeat the Bubbulfrog clinging to the cavern ceiling to collect its Bubbul Gem.
2887.chest_en: Defeat the Bubbulfrog to obtain a Bubbul Gem.

2286.place_zh: 在初始空岛西南湖边的高台上可以找到该神庙。
2286.place_en: Located on the terrace by the southwest lake on Great Sky Island.
2286.note_zh: 该神庙为剧情神庙，进入神庙后可以解锁能力余料建造。
2286.note_en: Main story tutorial shrine where Link unlocks the Fuse ability. Fuse boulders to weapons to smash stone pillars and walls.
2286.chest_zh: 本神庙共有两个宝箱分别位于破坏石墙后的左前方的柱子上方，打开宝箱可获得5支木箭，与右前方半空中，发射附带火焰果的箭矢可以使宝箱掉落至地面，打开可获得小钥匙。
2286.chest_en: Contains two chests: one on top of the left stone pillar containing Arrows x5, and another hanging on the right wall that drops when hit by a fire arrow, containing a Small Key.

1133.place_zh: 位于标点处，在进行利特村的主线任务时会来到此神庙。
1133.place_en: Located in the Hebra Sky Archipelago, visited during the Rito Village main quest line.
1133.note_zh: 使用弓箭射击栅栏后的柱子就能够将门打开，该神庙需要通过蹦床不断向上攀越，最后到达神庙终点即可。
1133.note_en: Shoot arrows through the barred window to hit the glowing switch and open the gate. Bounce continuously on trampolines while paragliding to reach the altar.
1133.chest_zh: 位于中间的高台位置，通过蹦床与滑翔伞即可到达，可获得十支木箭。
1133.chest_en: Located on an elevated platform in the middle. Bounce off a trampoline and glide onto the ledge to obtain Arrows x10.

1132.place_zh: 在海布拉山脉上空的空岛上可以找到该神庙。
1132.place_en: Located on the sky islands high above the Hebra Mountains.
1132.note_zh: 进入神庙后击败敌人捡到火龙头盾，随后使用火焰融化冰块继续前进，消灭左侧平台上的敌人拿到石板盾，石板盾可以挡住火焰，向右继续前进，使用余料建造将盾牌和导弹组合，按防御时可以激活导弹飞至空中，到达上层平台后即可完成该神庙。
1132.note_en: Defeat the Construct to obtain a Flame Emitter Shield, melt the ice blocks, pick up the stone slab shield to block flame jets, and fuse a Rocket to your shield to launch to the upper platform.
1132.chest_zh: 位于神庙入口不远处的右前方，融化冰块即可，打开宝箱可获得木箭x5。
1132.chest_en: Located on the right near the entrance. Melt the ice block enclosing the chest to obtain Arrows x5.

1131.place_zh: 直接前往标点位置即可，进行利特村时会路过，建议此时进行解锁。
1131.place_en: Located along the chain of floating sky islands leading to the Wind Temple.
1131.note_zh: 该神庙无需解谜直接开启。
1131.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
1131.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，可获得大的左纳乌能源。
1131.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

1130.place_zh: 该神庙位于东海布拉天空诸岛。
1130.place_en: Located in the East Hebra Sky Archipelago.
1130.note_zh: 此神庙需要找回神庙水晶，转动十字杆将弹射器对准旁边空岛的右前方。通过弹射器来到旁边空岛的下层，用火烧掉藤蔓。进入山洞后再次烧掉一面藤蔓墙后即可拿到水晶。
1130.note_en: Turn the launcher crank toward the lower right of the neighboring sky island. Catapult across, burn away the vines on the lower tier, and burn the interior vine wall to obtain the crystal.
1130.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得黄玉。
1130.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Topaz.

1129.place_zh: 在北洛美城堡上层大门前可以找到该神庙。
1129.place_en: Located right in front of the entrance to North Lomei Sky Labyrinth.
1129.note_zh: 神庙中的开关可以控制重力，当开关落下时重力为正常程度，当开关生气时则为失重状态，最终将球运输到坑中即可完成神庙，详情可点击左下角查看攻略。
1129.note_en: Strike the crystal switch to toggle low-gravity mode. Launch stone spheres across wide chasms into the target receptacles while gravity is reduced.
1129.chest_zh: 位于靶子下的凹室，打开可获得大的左纳乌能源。
1129.chest_en: Located in an alcove beneath the target switch. Launch yourself over in low gravity to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

1128.place_zh: 在空岛上可以直接找到该神庙，与神庙互动后寻找神庙水晶。
1128.place_en: Located on the sky island. Interact with the shrine to receive the green light guiding you to the crystal.
1128.note_zh: 跟随指引来到另一处空岛上与方块魔像战斗，胜利后即可获得水晶。
1128.note_en: Fly over to the neighboring sky island and defeat the Flux Construct to claim the crystal, then bring it back to the shrine.
1128.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得魔法杖。
1128.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Magic Rod.

1127.trial_zh: 战斗的教导 弓箭的精髓
1127.place_zh: 位于地图标注处的空岛。
1127.place_en: Located on Courage Island in the sky.
1127.note_zh: 与岛上的纹章互动开启勇气试炼，从前方伸出空岛的平台前跳下空岛，跟随绿圈下降落到下方神庙就会解锁，神庙内在半空中使用弓箭击败三只敌人即可。
1127.note_en: Complete the Dive Ceremony by diving from the top of Courage Island through all green rings to unlock the shrine. Inside, use aerial bow shots in bullet time to defeat three flying Constructs.
1127.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得魔像之刚弓。
1127.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Construct Bow.

1126.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 黑暗
1126.place_zh: 到达空岛位置就能看到纹章，互动会在前方空中出现绿色圆圈，随后从空岛中跳下依次穿过所有绿圈，成功穿过所有绿圈后该神庙现形。
1126.place_en: Located on Bravery Island in the sky. Complete the diving trial through all rings to manifest the shrine.
1126.note_zh: 该神庙需要玩家击败所有的敌人，最后前往终点即可完成，详细信息请点击左下角的查看攻略。
1126.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Navigate through pitch darkness with Flashlights and defeat all Soldier Constructs.
1126.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得光亮药。
1126.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Bright Elixir.

1125.place_zh: 位于海拉鲁丘陵上空的空岛处。
1125.place_en: Located in the sky archipelago high above Hyrule Ridge.
1125.note_zh: 该神庙前往下方的空岛击败一只上等方块魔像。并将下方空岛的水晶搬运到神庙前即可打开神庙。
1125.note_en: Defeat the Flux Construct III on the lower sky island to claim the shrine crystal, then use catapults and flying devices to carry it up to the shrine.
1125.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得钻石。
1125.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

1124.place_zh: 来空岛后首先触摸岸边的机关排走一些池塘里的水，前往被灯光照射的洞窟，破坏挡路的岩石进入洞穴，在洞穴内将镜子串联起来向洞穴的深处反射光线，到达最下层的房间后找到神庙。
1124.place_en: Touch the terminal on the sky island to drain water from the pool. Enter the cave, break rocks, and redirect beams of light using mirrors through the cavern depths to the shrine.
1124.note_zh: 该神庙位于洞穴深处的下层区域，跟着镜子反射的光线即可。
1124.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
1124.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得星星碎片。
1124.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Star Fragment.

1123.place_zh: 在初始空岛南侧，我们刚刚苏醒时的山洞上层中可以找到该神庙。
1123.place_en: Located on the upper tier of the Awakening Room cave on the south side of Great Sky Island.
1123.note_zh: 本神庙属于倒转乾坤能力的教学神庙，重点是使用倒转乾坤来拨动神庙内的齿轮。
1123.note_en: Tutorial shrine for the Recall ability. Cast Recall on rotating waterwheels and turning gear hands to ride them across gaps and synchronize clock hands.
1123.chest_zh: 含有十支木箭，需要跳到齿轮上并使用转乾坤能力来逆转齿轮的转动方向，到达宝箱位置。
1123.chest_en: Ride the large gear on the right and cast Recall to reverse its rotation to reach the chest containing Arrows x10.

1122.place_zh: 进入星见之岛的内部，来到内部后先转动中间的平台，使平台中间的镜子对准下图位置左上角的机关，同时让平台发出的光照到右前方平台上的镜子，之后将镜子折射的光线照射到激光上即可让神庙现形。
1122.place_en: Located inside Starview Island. Rotate the central mirror platform to reflect light beams into the receiving sensor to manifest the shrine.
1122.note_zh: 神庙本身没有解谜要素，只需要通过光线让神庙现形即可。
1122.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
1122.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开宝箱可获得星星碎片长杖。
1122.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Star Fragment Staff.

1120.place_zh: 在初始空岛东侧雪山的山顶可以找到该神庙。
1120.place_en: Located on the snowy mountain summit on the east side of Great Sky Island.
1120.note_zh: 该神庙为剧情神庙，进入神庙后可以解锁能力通天术。
1120.note_en: Main story tutorial shrine where Link unlocks the Ascend ability. Use Ascend to swim up through ceilings, pillars, and moving platforms.
1120.chest_zh: 位于上层区域，需要玩家使用通天术到达上层，打开宝箱可拿到魔像之弓。
1120.chest_en: Located in a wall alcove on the upper level. Stand beneath the overhanging ledge and use Ascend to obtain a Construct Bow.

1119.place_zh: 在时之神殿西侧的高台上可以找到该神庙。
1119.place_en: Located on the high terrace west of the Temple of Time on Great Sky Island.
1119.note_zh: 该神庙为剧情神庙，进入神庙后会解锁能力究极手。
1119.note_en: Main story tutorial shrine where Link unlocks the Ultrahand ability. Attach boards together to make bridges and attach hooks to iron cables to zip across chasms.
1119.chest_en: Located on a high wooden platform to the right. Attach two wooden boards together to create a ramp to reach the chest containing an Amber.

1118.place_zh: 到达标点处空岛就能找到，位置比较明显。
1118.place_en: Located on the sky island in the Central Hyrule Sky Archipelago.
1118.note_zh: 该神庙需要找到神庙水晶，使用神庙旁边的机关旋转前方的空岛，使延伸出来的部分与水晶所在的空岛连接，使用神庙旁边的机关旋转前方的空岛，使延伸出来的部分与水晶所在的空岛连接。
1118.note_en: Rotate the sky island mechanism so the bridge section connects to the island holding the crystal, retrieve the crystal, and bring it to the shrine.
1118.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得钻石。
1118.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

1117.place_zh: 在空岛上可以直接找到该神庙。
1117.place_en: Located directly on the sky island in the Gerudo Sky Archipelago.
1117.note_zh: 该神庙的重点是镜子的反射光，一步一步将反射光送往重点机关即可。
1117.note_en: Use mirrors to reflect sunlight from beam emitters onto orange hexagon switches to open gates and activate the final elevator.
1117.chest_zh: 在将近终点处，需要镜子点亮前方的机关打开栅栏门获得宝箱，打开可获得大的左纳乌能源。
1117.chest_en: Reflect sunlight with a mirror onto the switch above the gated alcove to open the door and obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

1029.place_zh: 该神庙位于南洛美城堡上层入口处，我们可以从附近的空岛触发搭乘一些飞行载具到达此处。
1029.place_en: Located at the entrance to South Lomei Sky Labyrinth.
1029.note_zh: 该神庙进入后与无解谜神庙的样子一样，但要注意，此神庙是有解谜的，点燃火箭将前方两个熄灭的火炬桩点燃，通过机关弹至空中后滑翔至终点即可完成该神庙。
1029.note_en: Shoot fire arrows or throw Fire Fruit to light the two unlit torches on the pillars, activating the catapult launcher to shoot you to the altar.
1029.chest_zh: 位于起点处，打开可获得魔像之刚弓。
1029.chest_en: Located near the entrance switch. Open the chest to obtain a Mighty Construct Bow.

1028.place_zh: 在岛上遗迹的最深处可以找到改神庙。
1028.place_en: Located in the deepest chamber of the Dragonhead Island ruins in the sky.
1028.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
1028.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
1028.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开后可获得钻石。
1028.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

1027.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 通电
1027.place_zh: 来到雷鸣之岛后找到滑轨，在滑轨旁找到一个已经拼接好了的T字形木板，随后用任意动力推动木板向前，在滑轨中段使用通天术向上，在空岛的内部可以找到该神庙。
1027.place_en: Ride the rail tracks on Thunderhead Isles on a T-shaped wooden plank, then use Ascend midway up into the island interior to find the shrine.
1027.note_zh: 该神庙为无法使用自带装备的孑然一身战，进入神庙拿到基本装备后直接向终点走即可。
1027.note_en: Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment. Equip provided weapons and defeat all electrified Soldier Constructs.
1027.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开后可获得电麻药，
1027.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain an Electro Elixir.

1026.place_zh: 在空岛上空可以直接找到该神庙。
1026.place_en: Located directly in the sky above West Necluda.
1026.note_zh: 该空岛需要收集水晶，转动空岛上的机关对准远处的空岛，随后将自己弹向该空岛，在空岛下层的山洞中可以找到该水晶。
1026.note_en: Rotate the catapult mechanism toward the distant sky island, launch yourself across, and retrieve the crystal from the cave on its lower level.
1026.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
1026.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Strong Zonaite Shield.

1025.place_zh: 在空岛中可以直接找到该神庙。
1025.place_en: Located on the sky island in the Lanayru Sky Archipelago.
1025.note_zh: 该神庙不可以直接进入，首先来到空岛另一侧操控机关，将前方和左侧的空岛链接在一起，抵达前方空岛拿到水晶，将水晶放在弧形桥上后再返回之前的空岛操控机关，将弧形桥转向当前所在平台即可。
1025.note_en: Operate the crank to rotate the curved bridge toward the island holding the crystal, retrieve the crystal, place it on the bridge, and turn the bridge back.
1025.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点处，打开后可获得大的左纳乌能源。
1025.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

994.place_zh: 在十字形的空岛上可以找到该神庙。
994.place_en: Located on the cross-shaped sky island.
994.note_zh: 将石板向前伸在拉回后使用倒转到达对面，将前方的生锈双手剑和石板组合，打破拦路的巨石后在前方用水龙头制造石板，推到前面再拉回来，随后使用倒转到达终点完成神庙。
994.note_en: Pour water onto lava using Hydrants to generate stone slabs, fuse a slab to a rusty claymore to smash boulders, and use Recall on slabs to reach the altar.
994.chest_zh: 在起点位置将左侧将石板举起再放下，使用倒转到达上层平台拿到宝箱，打开可获得魔像之刚弓。
994.chest_en: Raise a stone slab on the left near the start, lower it, stand underneath, and cast Recall to reach the chest containing a Mighty Construct Bow.

993.place_zh: 该神庙位于球形的空岛内部，通过侧面的洞口进入空岛，在空岛内部可以找到该神庙，把十字开关上的风扇取下可以使空岛不再旋转即可。
993.place_en: Located inside the hollow spherical sky island. Enter through the opening on the side, then remove the Fan on the cross crank to halt rotation.
993.note_zh: 在滑翔翼后方装一个风扇可以直接飞到终点。
993.note_en: Attach a Zonai Fan to the rear of a Wing glider and fly straight across the vast interior chasm to the altar.
993.chest_zh: 位于单独的高台中，打开可获得大的左纳尼乌姆。
993.chest_en: Located on an isolated high platform inside the sphere. Glide across to obtain Large Zonaite.

992.place_zh: 位于标点位置处，在推进主线任务时我们可以在水之神殿前找到该神庙。
992.place_en: Located in the sky archipelago right before the Water Temple.
992.note_zh: 该神庙解谜要素较为简单，直接进入水球中循序渐进到达终点即可。
992.note_en: Step inside floating water bubbles to ride them upward and across gaps through zero gravity.
992.chest_zh: 位于上层区域左侧，利用水泡阻止宝箱掉落从而拿到宝箱，打开宝箱后可以获得大的左纳乌能源。
992.chest_en: Located on the left side of the upper area. Intercept the falling chest with a water bubble to catch it and obtain a Large Zonai Charge.

991.place_zh: 在空岛上可以直接找到该神庙。
991.place_en: Located directly on the sky island in the Akkala Sky Archipelago.
991.note_zh: 利用空岛上的机关将我们打入圆球内部，转动岛内的圆球机关将洞口对准弹簧装置，随后利用弹簧装置将水晶和我们一同弹回空岛，该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
991.note_en: Catapult into the hollow sphere, rotate the inner sphere to align the opening with the spring device, and launch the crystal back to the island.
991.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开后可获得能量药。
991.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain an Energizing Elixir.

990.place_zh: 在空岛上可以直接找到该神庙。
990.place_en: Located on the sky island in the Deya Sky Archipelago.
990.note_zh: 先来空岛另一侧触摸纹章启动空岛上的机关，通过弹射机关不断向上，在高处的空岛上可以找到神庙水晶，将水晶直接从空中扔下，回到神庙将其打开，该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
990.note_en: Activate the terminal, launch upward through tiered sky islands, find the crystal on the highest island, and drop it down to the shrine.
990.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开可获得红宝石。
990.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Ruby.

989.place_zh: 在洛美岛上空遗迹的入口处可以找到该神庙。
989.place_en: Located at the entrance to the sky ruins above Lomei Labyrinth.
989.note_zh: 该神庙解谜流程较少，可以直接通过车到达终点。
989.note_en: Drive a motorized buggy across tracks and ramps over the abyss straight to the altar.
989.chest_zh: 位于撞碎前方的岩石后，打开可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
989.chest_en: Smash through the cracked boulders blocking the side alcove with the buggy to obtain a Strong Zonaite Shield.

957.trial_zh: 孑然一身之战 重力
957.place_zh: 通过瀑布向上抵达空岛，搭乘浮空平台向旁边更高的空岛前进，滑翔来到空岛下层的大门前，触摸纹章开启机关，通过空岛的上升气流向上，来到空岛最上层后通过中间的洞向下，在洞底部可以找到该神庙。
957.place_en: Climb waterfalls to reach the sky island, ride floating platforms upward, and dive straight down through the center tunnel of the cylindrical island to find the shrine at the bottom.
957.note_zh: 建议在挑战该神庙前先前往卓拉领地推进主线直至血会能力攀瀑，该神庙为无法使用自带装备的孑然一身战，消灭所有敌人即可。
957.note_en: Zora Armor recommended to swim up waterfalls. Proving Grounds trial prohibiting outside equipment with reduced gravity mechanics.
957.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点位置，打开后可获得大的左纳尼乌姆。
957.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain Large Zonaite.

956.place_zh: 在空岛上可以直接找到该神庙。
956.place_en: Located directly on the sky island in Necluda Sky Archipelago.
956.note_zh: 该神庙需要水晶，跟随指引来到另一处的空岛上与上等方块魔像战斗，胜利后把水晶运到神庙处即可。
956.note_en: Defeat the Flux Construct III on the neighboring sky island to obtain the crystal, then fly it back using a fan-propelled Wing.
956.chest_zh: 位于终点处，打开后可获得左纳尼乌姆之弓。
956.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Zonaite Bow.

940.place_zh: 在空岛上触摸纹章开启挑战，从空岛跳下穿过所有圆环，成功穿过所有圆环后即可使下层空岛上的神庙现形。
940.place_en: Activate the terminal on the sky island, dive down through all green rings in the sky, and land on the lower island to manifest the shrine.
940.note_zh: 该神庙无解谜，打开宝箱后直接完成神庙即可。
940.note_en: Rauru's Blessing. Enter the shrine to collect the treasure chest and Light of Blessing.
940.chest_zh: 位于神庙终点，打开可获得钻石。
940.chest_en: Located near the altar. Open the chest to obtain a Diamond.

939.place_zh: 来到空岛可以直接找到该神庙，神庙需要我们搬运水晶。
939.place_en: Located on the sky island. Retrieve the crystal from the highest island by cutting through vines on the middle tier.
939.note_zh: 转动十字开关将机关对准远处的空岛，来到远处的空岛后使用通天术向上，来到最高处空岛的中间层，切割藤蔓进入空岛内部可以找到水晶，神庙谜题的常规思路是用冷气果或者冰龙头在水中做冰块，然后利用坡道滑行加速让冰块装到前方的靶子，解谜要素较为简单。
939.note_en: Create ice blocks in the water pool using Ice Fruit or Frost Emitters, place the ice slab on the ramp, and slide it down into the target switch.
939.chest_zh: 位于栅栏内房间，打开宝箱后可获得左纳尼乌姆之坚盾。
939.chest_en: Located in a barred chamber. Slide a second ice block down to hit the side target and obtain a Strong Zonaite Shield.
